soldier: Head capsule pale yellow, labrum and antennae even paler, mandibles yellowish brown tinged with red; thorax and abdomen whitish tinged with yellow. Pilosity very sparse over the whole body. Head capsule rectangular, the sides parallel, the posterior margin slightly projecting outwards; frons flat, the dorsal margin of the head also flat. Antennae with 12 segments, segment 2 shortest, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2. Labrum square. Mandibles sabre-like, short and stout, the apex slightly curved; the length of the left mandible about equal to the head width; the serrations of the inner margin rather coarse, the re-entrant of the outer margin at the mandibular base very shallow. Postmentum distinctly projecting, the broad region near the anterior margin, the waist region near the posterior margin. The anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum both almost straight.
